affordances.name: FaceMesh
affordances.semantic: Sphere-based face mesh with 5 morph targets for expressions

affordances.name: SliderHappy
affordances.semantic: Range slider controlling Happy morph weight

checks.expr: (() => { const hs=["#slider-happy"]; const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')); const text=(tag,value)=>all.some(el=>(!tag||el.tagName.toLowerCase()===tag)&&String(el.textContent||'').trim().toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase())); return hs.some(raw=>{ const h=String(raw).trim(); if(!h)return false; try { if(document.querySelector(h))return true; } catch {} const id=h.replace(/^#/,''); if(/^[A-Za-z][\w:.-]*$/.test(id)&&document.getElementById(id))return true; const quoted=h.match(/^(?:([a-z]+)\s+)?(?:with\s+)?text\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]$/i)||h.match(/^([a-z]+)\s+labeled\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]$/i); if(quoted&&text((quoted[1]||'').toLowerCase(),quoted[2]))return true; const label=h.match(/^(.*?)(?:\s+button|\s+slider|\s+panel)$/i); return label ? text('',label[1]) : text('',h); }); })()

action.code: const s = document.getElementById('slider-happy'); if(s) { const nativeSet = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; nativeSet.call(s, '0.75'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }

const s1 = document.getElementById('slider-happy'); const s2 = document.getElementById('slider-sad'); const nativeSet = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; if(s1) { nativeSet.call(s1, '0.8'); s1.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); } setTimeout(() => { if(s2) { nativeSet.call(s2, '0.7'); s2.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); } }, 100);
